methodology.summary: DEMO FIXTURE. Scores are experimental 0–100 vulnerability proxies that combine Census affordability indicators with human-reviewed, corroborated image observations. They identify places to investigate under stated assumptions; they are not probabilities, forecasts, or ratings of any business or household.
limitations: All places, businesses, images and numbers in this fixture are invented.
Weights and the 0.20 affordability-gap cap are provisional, unvalidated choices.
Overlapping ACS five-year periods describe pooled estimates, not independent annual change.
Construction alone adds no risk; imagery only contributes alongside an affordability-change signal.
Missing evidence produces an unrated assessment, never a low score.
